Name: $_COOKIE['awcm_member']
Rationale: Cookie storing member ID for 'remember me'; validated against database in header.php lines 52-57.

Name: $_SESSION['awcm_cp']
Rationale: Control panel authorization session variable; checked in control/common.php line 16 to grant admin panel access.

Name: $_SESSION['awcm_member']
Rationale: Session variable storing authenticated member ID; used as authoritative identity source in header.php line 51.

Name: $member
Rationale: Represents the current authenticated user ID; sourced from $_SESSION['awcm_member'] or $_COOKIE['awcm_member'] in header.php lines 49-62. | Member identity object. Retrieved by f_find_member(). Used as identity source in authorization conditions.

Name: $member_level
Rationale: Member role/level determined by f_find_member($member,level) call; used for admin checks in header.php lines 66-73. | Member level/rank. Checked in conditional access gates throughout the member CP.

Name: acc_login
Rationale: Authenticates the submitted credentials, establishes the authenticated session on success, and returns a login-error response on failure.

Name: user
Rationale: Authenticated user object from auth.authenticate(). Checked with if user is not None before granting access (auth.login) or denying (render login page). Core identity parameter.

Name: $_COOKIE['security_level']
Rationale: Security level cookie set after login (login.php:103-111) and on security_level_set.php (line 63). Controls which security level (low/medium/high/666) applies to vulnerability pages. The '666' value bypasses all security levels. An authorization-related parameter.

Name: $_SESSION['admin']
Rationale: Stores the admin flag (0 or 1) set during login from the database 'admin' column. Used in security.php line 40 for AIM mode and represents the user's admin role.

Name: $_SESSION['login']
Rationale: Stores the authenticated username after successful login. Checked in security.php (line 45: isset($_SESSION['login']) && $_SESSION['login']) to enforce authentication. Displayed in UI headers. Core identity parameter.

Name: admin_required
Rationale: Decorator that checks the user is active AND is_superuser. Raises Http404 if not.

Name: lecturer_required
Rationale: Decorator that checks the user is active AND has is_lecturer=True or is_superuser=True. Raises Http404 if not.

Name: student_required
Rationale: Decorator that checks the user is active AND has is_student=True or is_superuser=True. Raises Http404 if not.

Name: request.user
Rationale: Django request.user object central to all authentication and role checks in the LMS app.

Name: request.user.has_perm
Rationale: Django permission-check method used in a terminating authorization condition.

Name: request.user.is_active
Rationale: Active-user flag checked inside student_required, lecturer_required, and admin_required decorators before granting role-based access.

Name: request.user.is_lecturer
Rationale: Custom flag checked in lecturer_required decorator to verify user has lecturer role.

Name: request.user.is_student
Rationale: Custom flag checked in student_required decorator to verify user has student role.

Name: request.user.is_superuser
Rationale: Flag checked in admin_required and lecturer_required/student_required decorators as override for full access.

Name: Post.status
Rationale: Post status field (0=draft, 1=published). Used as access control: PostList filters to status=1 (published), and PostDetail should restrict draft access to staff users.

Name: dvwaPageStartup
Rationale: If called with 'authenticated' action, redirects to login.php if dvwaIsLoggedIn() is false. Used by security.php, about.php, instructions.php, setup.php to protect pages that require authentication.

Name: dvwaisloggedin
Rationale: Represents the authentication-state predicate used by terminating redirect guards such as dvwaPageStartup().

Name: checkUser
Rationale: Authorization guard: redirects to login.php if $_SESSION['validUser'] is not set or is not true. Called from admin pages to protect them.

Name: $_SESSION['userName']
Rationale: Authenticated administrator identity stored in the session after login and reused in administrator-sensitive database operations.

Name: $_SESSION['validUser']
Rationale: Session boolean flag indicating whether the user has authenticated successfully. Set to true after login, checked by checkUser() for protected page access.

Name: type
Rationale: Session attribute set at login (Login.java:67). Used for admin authorization checks: sessionType.equals("Admin") in ChangeMessage:41, DeleteForum:27, DeleteReply:29, DeleteThread:27.

Name: user
Rationale: Message author loaded from forum_message.user and compared with sessionUsername to decide whether the current user may edit the message.

Name: username
Rationale: Session attribute set at login (Login.java:57), used as identity for authorization in ChangeMessage.java:41-53 and ChangeProfile.java:44-52. Core identity parameter throughout the application.

Name: isLoggedIn
Rationale: Session attribute set to 'true' on successful login; checked by auth.jsp to gate admin access.

Name: administrator
Rationale: Role checked via serverInterface.isUserInRole('administrator') in processViewEntry, processVoteEntry, processSpamEntry, processVoteComment, processSpamComment. Determines elevated privileges for admin operations.

Name: trusted
Rationale: Role obtained through serverInterface.isUserInRole('trusted') and propagated to saveEntry/saveBlogEntry, where it controls trusted-user HTML handling.

Name: check_forum_password
Rationale: Validates the forum-password cookie and propagates the failed decision through $showform to a terminating branch.

Name: check_forum_password_archive
Rationale: Checks the forum-password cookie and directly invokes the archive denial routine in the rejecting branch.

Name: adminHandler
Rationale: Rejects requests unless the current user is a super administrator.

Name: canAuth
Rationale: Like mustAuth but optional — injects user into context if authenticated, but allows unauthenticated requests through. Used for public pages that show different content based on auth state.

Name: editComment
Rationale: Enforces the topic read-only policy and rejects disallowed comment operations.

Name: getAuthSignUp
Rationale: Validates the domain signup policy and signup capability token before showing registration.

Name: mustAuth
Rationale: HTTP middleware that validates JWT token, extracts user_id claim, verifies user exists and isn't banned/logged-out, then injects *models.User into request context via CtxUserKey. Core authentication gate.

Name: postAuthSignIn
Rationale: Enforces the domain policy controlling whether password-based sign-in is permitted.

Name: postAuthSignUp
Rationale: Validates the domain signup policy and signup capability token before creating an account.

Name: postCategory
Rationale: Rejects category updates outside the current administrator's domain or role.

Name: postCreateMod
Rationale: Enforces the super-administrator requirement before creating a moderator.

Name: postDeleteMod
Rationale: Enforces super-administrator and same-domain checks before deleting a moderator.

Name: profileHandler
Rationale: Enforces authentication, ownership, same-domain, and moderator-role checks for profile changes.

Name: domain.IsRegularSigninEnabled
Rationale: Controls whether password-based sign-in is permitted for the domain; disabled sign-in is rejected with HTTP 403.

Name: IsSuperAdmin
Rationale: User struct boolean field. Checked in comments.go:89 and topics.go:103 for sticky/readonly override. Also used in admin.go for admin page access.

Name: IsSuperMod
Rationale: User struct boolean field. Same authorization role as IsSuperAdmin for sticky/readonly privileges.

Name: modUser.DomainID
Rationale: Compared with the active domain before moderator deletion; a mismatch is rejected with HTTP 403.

Name: signupToken
Rationale: Acts as a registration capability token and is checked in terminating HTTP 403 signup guards.

Name: topic.IsReadOnly
Rationale: Prevents comment submission to a read-only topic and enforces the decision with HTTP 403.

Name: user
Rationale: Represents the current authenticated principal; a nil value blocks profile modification with HTTP 403.

Name: _SESSION['auth']
Rationale: Primary authentication flag set to 'yes' on successful login in login.php (line 91). Checked in auth.php (line 32) as the main gate for all admin pages.

Name: _SESSION['path']
Rationale: Path verification token set during login (login.php line 92). Checked in auth.php (line 37) to prevent session fixation/hijacking by comparing against current directory path.

Name: _SESSION['permissions']
Rationale: Comma-separated permission string (12 positions: createranks,manageranks,loginrecords,preferences,loggingin,createarticles,approve,editarticles,deletearticles,createusers,editusers,deleteusers). Assigned to $globalvars['rank'] array in auth.php (line 42). Checked throughout admin pages to authorize specific operations.

Name: _SESSION['userID']
Rationale: Stores the database user ID from the users table, set during login (login.php line 89). Used for logging operations.

Name: _SESSION['username']
Rationale: Stores authenticated username set during login (login.php line 88). Used for identity tracking in logging and as author for new content.

Name: $globalvars['rank'][10]
Rationale: Controls article creation and redirects denied requests to permissiondenied.

Name: $globalvars['rank'][14]
Rationale: Controls article editing and redirects denied requests to permissiondenied.

Name: $globalvars['rank'][16]
Rationale: Controls article deletion and redirects denied requests to permissiondenied.

Name: $globalvars['rank'][18]
Rationale: Controls user creation and redirects denied requests to permissiondenied.

Name: $globalvars['rank'][20]
Rationale: Controls user editing and redirects denied requests to permissiondenied.

Name: $globalvars['rank'][22]
Rationale: Controls user deletion and redirects denied requests to permissiondenied.

Name: $globalvars['rank'][2]
Rationale: Controls rank-management operations and redirects denied requests to permissiondenied.

Name: $globalvars['rank'][4]
Rationale: Controls access to login records and redirects denied requests to permissiondenied.

Name: $globalvars['rank'][6]
Rationale: Controls preference management and redirects denied requests to permissiondenied.

Name: rank
Rationale: Aliased from $_SESSION['permissions'] to $globalvars['rank'] array. Each index maps to a specific permission: [0]=create_ranks, [2]=manage_ranks, [4]=login_records, [6]=preferences, [8]=logging_in, [10]=create_articles, [12]=approve, [14]=edit_articles, [16]=delete_articles, [18]=create_users, [20]=edit_users, [22]=delete_users.

Name: $_COOKIE[$string_cook_login]
Rationale: Cookie-based admin auth: stores login name. Checked at top of admin pages to verify admin session.

Name: $_COOKIE[$string_cook_password]
Rationale: Cookie-based admin auth: stores password. Checked alongside login cookie for admin access.

Name: is_admin
Rationale: Checks if $_SESSION['privilege'] == 'admin'. Core role-based authorization function used throughout the app. Called by require_admin(), header.php for conditional menu display, and comments.php for moderation UI.

Name: require_admin
Rationale: Authorization gate: terminates with error if is_admin() returns false. Called in comments.php:46 to protect comment moderation (delete/approve). Hard enforcement of admin-only operations.

Name: require_loggedin
Rationale: Authentication gate: terminates with error if getEmail() returns FALSE (user not logged in). Called in comments.php:77 before comment submission. Ensures only authenticated users can post.

Name: $_SESSION['privilege']
Files: functions.php | header.php | login.php | generaloptions.php | comments.php | register.php
Rationale: Stores the user's privilege level ('admin' or 'user') set during login. Checked by is_admin() (functions.php:16) to authorize admin-only actions including comment moderation, user management, and options editing. Core authorization parameter.

Name: $_SESSION['user_id']
Rationale: Stores the authenticated user's database ID set during login. Retrieved by getUserID() (functions.php:53) for resource ownership queries (e.g., associating comments with a user). Core identity parameter.

Name: require_login
Rationale: Authorization gate: redirects to users login page if not authenticated. Called from protected pages like users/home.php, pictures/view.php.

Name: $_SESSION['userid']
Rationale: Session variable storing authenticated frontend user ID. Set by Users::login_user(), used by Users::current_user() to determine identity.
